        ...c,
        subtotal: c.items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + (Number(it.total) || 0), 0),
        itemsCount: c.items.length
      }));

      const finalSheet: CosteoSheet = {
        ...targetSheet,
        categories: updatedCategories
      };

      const sheetExists = sheets.some(s => s.id === finalSheet.id);
      const newSheets = sheetExists
        ? sheets.map(s => s.id === finalSheet.id ? finalSheet : s)
        : [finalSheet, ...sheets];

      setSheets(newSheets);
      setActiveTabId(finalSheet.id);
      if (!openTabs.includes(finalSheet.id)) {
        setOpenTabs(prev => [...prev, finalSheet.id]);
      }

      await Promise.all(apiCalls);

      setIsPreviewMode(false);
      setPreviewConteosData(null);
      setConteosSuccessToast(`✓ ${totalCountSumados} insumos sumados exitosamente a la Hoja de Costeo Diario`);
      setTimeout(() => setConteosSuccessToast(''), 5000);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error('Error al confirmar conteos importados:', err);
      alert('Ocurrió un error al guardar los conteos en la base de datos.');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingPreview(false);
    }
  };

  // Handlers para el módulo de Añadir Conteos
  const handleParseConteos = (text: string) => {
    const parsed = parseBulkConteosText(text, catalogItems);
    setParsedConteosList(parsed);
  };

  const handleLoadSampleConteos = () => {
    const sample = `Huevos 30
Leche 3
Filetes 350 - 4
Chicharron grande 4
Lomo 350 - 2
Salmón 4
Lengua 3
Churrasco 4
Baby bef 1
Punta de anca 3
Chorizo pequeño 19
Costilla ahumada 4 kls
Chorizo grande 1
Trucha 1
Mix de mariscos 2.5
Camarón 2.1 kls
Tilapia 3
Trucha 8`;
    setConteosRawText(sample);
    handleParseConteos(sample);
  };

  const handleUpdateParsedItemQty = (itemId: string, newQty: number, newQtyStr?: string) => {
    setParsedConteosList(prev => prev.map(item => {
      if (item.id !== itemId) return item;
      const calc = computeConteoItemEquivAndTotal(
        newQty,
        item.inputUnit,
        item.itemName,
        item.category,
        item.stdPortionWeight,
        item.unitPrice,
        item.catalogItem
      );
      return {
        ...item,
        rawQty: newQty,
        rawQtyStr: newQtyStr !== undefined ? newQtyStr : String(newQty),
        weightKg: calc.weightKg,
        baseUnit: calc.baseUnit,
        presentation: calc.presentation,
        estimatedTotal: calc.estimatedTotal
      };
    }));
  };

  const handleUpdateParsedItemUnit = (itemId: string, newUnit: string) => {
    setParsedConteosList(prev => prev.map(item => {
      if (item.id !== itemId) return item;
      const calc = computeConteoItemEquivAndTotal(
        item.rawQty,
        newUnit,
        item.itemName,
        item.category,
        item.stdPortionWeight,
        item.unitPrice,
        item.catalogItem
      );
      return {
        ...item,
        inputUnit: newUnit,
        weightKg: calc.weightKg,
        baseUnit: calc.baseUnit,
        presentation: calc.presentation,
        estimatedTotal: calc.estimatedTotal
      };
    }));
  };

  const handleUpdateParsedItemPrice = (itemId: string, newPrice: number) => {
    setParsedConteosList(prev => prev.map(item => {
      if (item.id !== itemId) return item;
      const calc = computeConteoItemEquivAndTotal(
        item.rawQty,
        item.inputUnit,
        item.itemName,
        item.category,
        item.stdPortionWeight,
        newPrice,
        item.catalogItem
      );
      return {
        ...item,
        unitPrice: newPrice,
        weightKg: calc.weightKg,
        baseUnit: calc.baseUnit,
        presentation: calc.presentation,
        estimatedTotal: calc.estimatedTotal
      };
    }));
  };

  const handleRemoveParsedItem = (itemId: string) => {
    setParsedConteosList(prev => prev.filter(it => it.id !== itemId));
  };

  const handleApplyConteos = () => {
    if (!activeSheet || parsedConteosList.length === 0) return;

    const targetType: 'INVENTARIO_INICIAL_COCINA' | 'BODEGA_A_COCINA' | 'DEVOLUCION_COCINA' | 'COCINA_CIERRE' | 'BODEGA_APERTURA' | 'BODEGA_CIERRE' =
      conteosTargetView === 'COCINA_APERTURA' ? 'INVENTARIO_INICIAL_COCINA' :
      conteosTargetView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' ? 'DEVOLUCION_COCINA' :
      conteosTargetView === 'COCINA_CIERRE' ? 'COCINA_CIERRE' :
      conteosTargetView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA' ? 'BODEGA_APERTURA' :
      conteosTargetView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE' ? 'BODEGA_CIERRE' : 'BODEGA_A_COCINA';

    const now = new Date();
    const horaAuto = now.toLocaleTimeString('es-CO', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });

    let updatedCategories = [...activeSheet.categories];

    parsedConteosList.forEach(pItem => {
      const targetCatId = mapCategoryToGroupId(pItem.category);
      let cat: CategoryGroup | undefined = updatedCategories.find(c => {
        if (c.id === targetCatId) return true;
        const cNorm = normalizeStrHelper(c.name);
        if (targetCatId === 'verduras' && (cNorm.includes('verdura') || cNorm.includes('fruver'))) return true;
        if (targetCatId === 'carnes' && (cNorm.includes('carne') || cNorm.includes('prote'))) return true;
        if (targetCatId === 'granos' && (cNorm.includes('grano') || cNorm.includes('abarrote') || cNorm.includes('lacteo'))) return true;
        if (targetCatId === 'bebidas' && (cNorm.includes('bebida') || cNorm.includes('licor') || cNorm.includes('cerveza') || cNorm.includes('gaseosa'))) return true;
        if (targetCatId === 'desechables' && (cNorm.includes('desechable') || cNorm.includes('empaque'))) return true;
        return false;
      });

      if (!cat) {
        const catNames: Record<string, string> = {
          verduras: 'Verduras e Insumos',
          carnes: 'Carnes y Proteínas',
          granos: 'Granos y Abarrotes',
          bebidas: 'Bebidas',
          desechables: 'Desechables y Empaques'
        };
        const newCat: CategoryGroup = {
          id: targetCatId,
          name: catNames[targetCatId] || 'Insumos Varios',
          items: [],
          subtotal: 0,
          itemsCount: 0
        };
        updatedCategories.push(newCat);
        cat = newCat;
      }

      const activeCat = cat;

      const newReg: InsumoRegistro = {
        id: `reg-bulk-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`,
        hora: horaAuto,
        usuario: 'Administradora',
        tipo: targetType,
        presentacion: pItem.presentation,
        origen: conteosTargetView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' ? 'Cocina Principal' : 'Bodega General',
        destino: conteosTargetView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' ? 'Bodega General' : 'Cocina Principal',
        cantidad: pItem.weightKg,
        unidad: pItem.baseUnit,
        costoUnitario: pItem.unitPrice,
        total: pItem.estimatedTotal,
        detalleCalculo: pItem.presentation === 'Porcion' ? `${pItem.rawQty} porciones (${pItem.weightKg} Kg)` : `${pItem.rawQty} ${pItem.inputUnit}`,
        observaciones: conteosActionMode === 'SUMAR' 
          ? `Bajada / conteo adicional (+) (${conteosTargetView})` 
          : `Reemplazo / corrección de valor (=) (${conteosTargetView})`
      };

      const existingItem = activeCat.items.find(it => normalizeStrHelper(it.name) === normalizeStrHelper(pItem.itemName));

      if (existingItem) {
        let updatedRegs: InsumoRegistro[] = [];
        if (conteosActionMode === 'SUMAR') {
          // Modo Sumar: acumula como un registro adicional al historial
          updatedRegs = [...(existingItem.registros || []), newReg];
        } else {
          // Modo Reemplazar: sustituye los registros previos de este mismo tipo/destino
          const otherTypeRegs = (existingItem.registros || []).filter(r => r.tipo !== targetType);
          updatedRegs = [...otherTypeRegs, newReg];
        }

        const newTotalQty = Number(updatedRegs.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.tipo === 'DEVOLUCION_COCINA' ? -r.cantidad : r.cantidad), 0).toFixed(2));
        const newTotalCost = Math.round(newTotalQty * (existingItem.unitPrice || pItem.unitPrice));

        const updatedItem: InsumoItem = {
          ...existingItem,
          qty: Math.max(0, newTotalQty),
          total: Math.max(0, newTotalCost),
          registros: updatedRegs
        };

        updatedCategories = updatedCategories.map(c => {
          if (c.id !== activeCat.id) return c;
          return {
            ...c,
            items: c.items.map(it => it.id === existingItem.id ? updatedItem : it)
          };
        });
      } else {
        const newItem: InsumoItem = {
          id: `it-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`,
          name: pItem.itemName,
          qty: pItem.weightKg,
          unit: pItem.baseUnit,
          unitPrice: pItem.unitPrice,
          total: pItem.estimatedTotal,
          registros: [newReg]
        };

        updatedCategories = updatedCategories.map(c => {
          if (c.id !== activeCat.id) return c;
          return {
            ...c,
            items: [...c.items, newItem]
          };
        });
      }
    });

    // Recalcular subtotales y conteo de items de cada categoría
    updatedCategories = updatedCategories.map(c => ({
      ...c,
      subtotal: c.items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + (Number(it.total) || 0), 0),
      itemsCount: c.items.length
    }));

    const updatedSheet: CosteoSheet = {
      ...activeSheet,
      categories: updatedCategories
    };

    setSheets(sheets.map(s => s.id === activeSheet.id ? updatedSheet : s));
    setActiveOperationalView(conteosTargetView);
    setIsConteosDrawerOpen(false);
    setConteosSuccessToast(`✓ ${parsedConteosList.length} conteos guardados (${conteosActionMode === 'SUMAR' ? 'adicionados +' : 'reemplazados ='})`);
    setTimeout(() => setConteosSuccessToast(''), 4000);

    // Persistir conteos masivos en Supabase vía POST /api/costeo-diario
    const itemsPayload = parsedConteosList.map(p => ({
      insumo_id: (p as any).catalogItemId || null,
      nombre_insumo: p.itemName,
      categoria: p.category,
      cantidad: p.weightKg,
      unidad: p.baseUnit,
      costo_unitario: p.unitPrice,
      total: p.estimatedTotal,
      observaciones: p.presentation === 'Porcion' ? `${p.rawQty} porciones (${p.weightKg} Kg)` : `${p.rawQty} ${p.inputUnit}`
    }));

    const targetDateToSave = activeSheet.dateStr;
    const currentTargetView = conteosTargetView;
    const currentActionMode = conteosActionMode;

    setConteosRawText('');
    setParsedConteosList([]);

    fetch('/api/costeo-diario', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        fecha: targetDateToSave,
        targetView: currentTargetView,
        actionMode: currentActionMode,
        items: itemsPayload
      })
    })
      .then(async res => {
        if (!res.ok) {
          const errJson = await res.json();
          throw new Error(errJson.error || 'Error al persistir');
        }
        // Re-sincronizar con base de datos para garantizar consistencia total
        const r = await fetch('/api/costeo-diario');
        const d = await r.json();
        if (d?.sheets && Array.isArray(d.sheets) && d.sheets.length > 0) {
          setSheets(d.sheets);
        }
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('Error persistiendo conteos masivos en Supabase:', err);
      });
  };

  // Catálogo efectivo y buscador comprensivo unificado para el input general superior
  const effectiveGeneralCatalog = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' && productosVentaList.length > 0) {
      const prodsFormatted = productosVentaList.map(p => {
        const price = Number(p.precio_total || p.precio_neto || p.precio_venta || p.costo_estimado || 0);
        return {
          id: p.id,
          nombre: p.nombre,
          categoria: 'Consumido de Productos para la Venta',
          costo_unitario_kg: price,
          precio_total: price,
          unidad_medida: p.unidad || 'Und'
        };
      });
      return [...prodsFormatted, ...catalogItems];
    }
    return catalogItems;
  }, [activeOperationalView, productosVentaList, catalogItems]);

  const filteredGeneralCatalog = useMemo(() => {
    return searchCatalogComprehensive(newInsumoName, effectiveGeneralCatalog, searchCategoryFilter);
  }, [newInsumoName, effectiveGeneralCatalog, searchCategoryFilter]);

  const generalParsedAddQty = evaluateQtyFormula(newInsumoQtyFormula).value || 0;
  const generalSelectedUnitOpt = availableUnits.find(u => u.value === newInsumoUnit);
  const generalUnitFactor = generalSelectedUnitOpt ? generalSelectedUnitOpt.toBaseFactor(selectedCatalogItem) : 1;
  const generalConvertedBaseQty = Number((generalParsedAddQty * generalUnitFactor).toFixed(2));
  const generalEstimatedCost = Math.round(generalConvertedBaseQty * (Number(newInsumoPrice) || 0));

  const generalPreviewCategory = useMemo(() => {
    if (!newInsumoName.trim()) return null;
    return determineTargetCategory(newInsumoName, selectedCatalogItem, activeOperationalView);
  }, [newInsumoName, selectedCatalogItem, activeOperationalView]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-[calc(100dvh-53px)] md:h-[calc(100vh-57px)] -m-2.5 sm:-m-4 md:-m-6 -mb-20 md:mb-0 bg-white overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* ============================================================ */}
      {/* SECCIÓN SUPERIOR STICKY / FIJA: PESTAÑAS + SUBHEADER ACCIONES*/}
      {/* Toda esta sección se queda quieta al hacer scroll down       */}
      {/* ============================================================ */}
      <div className="shrink-0 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 z-20 shadow-2xs">
        
        {/* 1. BARRA DE PESTAÑAS (TABS) */}
        <div className="bg-slate-100/90 border-b border-slate-200 px-3 pt-2 flex items-center justify-between overflow-x-auto select-none">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
            
            {/* Tab principal: Vistas de Costeo */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTabId(null)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-t-md transition-colors border-t-2 ${
                activeTabId === null
                  ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 border-orange-600 font-semibold shadow-2xs border-x border-slate-200'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 border-transparent hover:bg-slate-200/60 font-medium'
              }`}
            >
              <TableProperties className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Vistas de Costeo</span>
            </button>

            {/* Pestañas de Hojas Abiertas */}
            {openTabs.map(tabId => {
              const sh = sheets.find(s => s.id === tabId);
              if (!sh) return null;
              const isActive = activeTabId === tabId;

              return (
                <div
                  key={tabId}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTabId(tabId)}
                  className={`group flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-t-md cursor-pointer transition-all border-t-2 max-w-[240px] ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 border-orange-600 font-semibold shadow-2xs border-x border-slate-200'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 border-transparent hover:bg-slate-200/60 font-medium'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FileSpreadsheet className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 ${isActive ? 'text-orange-600' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                  <span className="truncate">{sh.title.split(' - ')[0]}</span>
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => handleCloseTab(e, tabId)}

                    title="Cerrar pestaña"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {/* Botón "+" para crear o abrir nueva hoja */}
            {!isCerrado && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
              className="p-1.5 ml-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center"
              title="Crear nueva hoja de costeo"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. SUBHEADER DE LA HOJA ACTIVA (Fijo junto con pestañas al abrir una hoja) */}
        {activeSheet && (
          <div className="bg-white p-3 px-4 md:px-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTabId(null)}
                  className="text-xs text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 px-2 py-1 rounded transition-colors"

                  <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Volver a Hojas de Costeo</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-base md:text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
                {activeSheet.title}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Fecha: <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{activeSheet.dateStr}</span> · {activeSheet.categories.reduce((acc, c) => acc + c.items.length, 0)} insumos registrados
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Botones en el subheader para Acciones de la Hoja (Móvil nativo: 2 columnas completas) */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:flex sm:items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0 mt-1 sm:mt-0">

                </div>

              {/* Botón Principal: Añadir Conteos (Se mantiene visible) */}

                    refreshCatalog(conteosRawText);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 sm:py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg sm:rounded-md transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer group touch-manipulation active:scale-95 whitespace-nowrap"
                  title="Añadir conteos de texto rápido"

                  <ClipboardList className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 group-hover:text-slate-900" />
                  <span>Añadir Conteos</span>
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Botón Desplegable Único de Utilidades (Exportar informe, Importar conteos, Limpiar hoja) */}
              <div className="relative" ref={utilidadesMenuRef}>
                <button

                  title="Utilidades (Exportar informe, importar conteos, limpiar hoja)"
                >
                  <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 group-hover:text-slate-900" />
                  <span>Utilidades</span>
                  <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 transition-transform duration-150 ${isUtilidadesOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                </button>

                {isUtilidadesOpen && (
                  <div className="absolute right-0 mt-1.5 w-48 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl z-50 py-1 divide-y divide-slate-100 animate-fade-in ring-1 ring-slate-900/5">
                    <div className="py-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setIsUtilidadesOpen(false);
                          handleExportInformePdf();
                        }}
                        className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        title="Exportar informe de inventarios y cierres en PDF"
                      >
                        <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
                        <span>Exportar informe</span>
                      </button>

                      {!isSheetCerrado && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setIsUtilidadesOpen(false);
                            setIsImportTxtModalOpen(true);
                          }}
                          className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          title="Importar conteos estructurados mediante archivo TXT o fotos con IA"
                        >
                          <UploadCloud className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
                          <span>Importar Conteos</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {!isSheetCerrado && (
                      <div className="py-1">
                        <button

                            setIsUtilidadesOpen(false);
                            setIsClearModalOpen(true);
                          }}
                          className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          title="Limpiar hoja y resetear datos de base de datos"
                        >
                          <Eraser className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" />
                          <span>Limpiar hoja</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================ */}
      {/* 2. ÁREA PRINCIPAL CON SCROLL EXCLUSIVO PARA LOS LISTADOS      */}
      {/* ============================================================ */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto min-h-0 bg-white">
        {isPreviewMode && previewConteosData ? (

        ) : isLoadingSheets ? (

          </div>
        ) : activeTabId === null || !activeSheet ? (

          {/* Sub-Sidebar Lateral: Meses Dinámicos */}
          <MonthSidebar

            onSelectMonth={setSelectedMonth}

          {/* Contenido Central: Hojas de Costeo */}

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">

                </p>
              </div>
              {!isCerrado && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button

                    title="Importar conteos masivos por TXT / IA"
                  >
                    <UploadCloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                    <span>Importar Conteos</span>
                  </button>
                  <button

                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Nueva Hoja de Costeo</span>
                </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Buscador */}
            <div className="relative mb-3">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
              <input

              />
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3 font-medium">
              {filteredSheets.length} {filteredSheets.length === 1 ? 'hoja registrada' : 'hojas registradas'}

            {/* Listado de Tarjetas Minimalistas */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {filteredSheets.map(sh => {

                const isOpen = openTabs.includes(sh.id);

                return (

                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      <div className="p-2 rounded-md bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 group-hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors mt-0.5 sm:mt-0">
                        <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-orange-600 transition-colors">
                            {sh.title}
                          </h3>
                          {isOpen && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-slate-200">
                              Abierta en pestaña
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                          <span>{sh.categories.reduce((acc, c) => acc + c.items.length, 0)} insumos registrados</span>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                            Costo total: ${totalCOP.toLocaleString('es-CO')} COP
                          </span>
                          {sh.posSales > 0 && (
                            <>
                              <span>•</span>
                              <span>Venta POS: ${sh.posSales.toLocaleString('es-CO')}</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-center">
                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleOpenSheet(sh.id);
                        }}
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors"
                      >
                        Abrir
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      ) : (

        /* ------------------------------------------------------------ */
        /* VISTA 2: HOJA ACTIVA EN CONSTRUCCIÓN (Sobria, estilo GitHub) */
        /* ------------------------------------------------------------ */

          <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-6 items-start w-full">
            
            {/* Columna Izquierda: Listados de Insumos */}
            <div className="flex-1 w-full min-w-0 space-y-3.5">

              {/* -------------------------------------------------------- */}
              {/* SELECTOR DE VISTAS OPERATIVAS (Scroll horizontal estilizado) */}
              {/* Permite alternar rápidamente entre Cocina, Consumos y Bodega */}
              {/* -------------------------------------------------------- */}
              <div className="bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto select-none shadow-inner border border-slate-200/80 scrollbar-none">
                <button

                    activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'

                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono">
                      {clearSheetStats.apertura.count}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"

                    activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200/60'

                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono">
                      {clearSheetStats.movimientos.count}

                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"

                    activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>Devoluciones</span>
                  {clearSheetStats.devoluciones.count > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono">
                      {clearSheetStats.devoluciones.count}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('COCINA_CIERRE')}
                  className={`shrink-0 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation ${
                    activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200/60'

                >
                  <span>Cierre</span>
                  {clearSheetStats.cierre.count > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono">
                      {clearSheetStats.cierre.count}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                <span className="h-4 w-px bg-slate-300 mx-0.5 shrink-0" />

                <button
                  type="button"

                    activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS'
                      ? 'bg-white text-purple-900 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-purple-200'
                      : 'text-purple-700 hover:text-purple-900 hover:bg-purple-50/60'

                <span className="h-4 w-px bg-slate-300 mx-0.5 shrink-0" />

                <button
                  type="button"

                    activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'

                >
                  <span>Bodega Apertura</span>
                  {clearSheetStats.bodegaApertura.count > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono">

                    activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>Bodega Cierre</span>
                  {clearSheetStats.bodegaCierre.count > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono">
                      {clearSheetStats.bodegaCierre.count}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* -------------------------------------------------------- */}
              {/* RESUMEN FINANCIERO MÓVIL (Tarjeta Nativa de Alta Visibilidad) */}
              {/* -------------------------------------------------------- */}
              <div className="lg:hidden bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl p-3 shadow-md space-y-2">

                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xl font-black font-mono text-white">
                      ${consumoReal.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-bold block">

                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-slate-800/80 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-medium">+Traslados</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold font-mono text-emerald-300 tracking-tight">
                      +${Math.round(costoTraslados).toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-slate-800/80 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-medium">-Devoluc.</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold font-mono text-amber-300 tracking-tight">
                      -${Math.round(totalDevoluciones).toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-slate-800/80 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-400 font-medium">-Cierre</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold font-mono text-rose-300 tracking-tight">
                      -${Math.round(costoCierre).toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* -------------------------------------------------------- */}
              {/* BARRA SUPERIOR DE VISTA OPERATIVA Y SWITCHES MINIMALISTAS */}
              {/* -------------------------------------------------------- */}
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 px-4 shadow-2xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    {activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && 'Traslados Bodega a Cocina'}
                    {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA' && 'Cocina Apertura (Inventario Inicial)'}
                    {activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' && 'Devoluciones Cocina a Bodega'}
                    {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE' && 'Cocina Cierre'}
                    {activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' && 'Consumos (Insumos y Productos de Venta)'}
                    {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA' && 'Bodega Apertura'}
                    {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE' && 'Bodega Cierre'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium border border-slate-200">
                    Operación Activa
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Switches Minimalistas exclusivos de la vista Traslados */}
                {activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4 text-xs select-none">
                    {/* Switch 1: Incluir Cocina Apertura */}
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer group py-0.5">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        role="switch"
                        aria-checked={incluirCocinaApertura}
                        onClick={() => setIncluirCocinaApertura(!incluirCocinaApertura)}
                        className={`relative inline-flex h-4 w-7 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out focus:outline-none ${
                          incluirCocinaApertura ? 'bg-slate-900' : 'bg-slate-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-3 w-3 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow ring-0 transition duration-200 ease-in-out ${
                            incluirCocinaApertura ? 'translate-x-3' : 'translate-x-0'
                          }`}
                        />
                      </button>
                      <span className={`text-xs transition-colors ${incluirCocinaApertura ? 'text-slate-900 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
                        Incluir Cocina Apertura
                      </span>
                    </label>

                    <div className="hidden sm:block h-4 w-px bg-slate-200" />

                    {/* Switch 2: Incluir Devoluciones */}
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer group py-0.5">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        role="switch"
                        aria-checked={incluirDevoluciones}
                        onClick={() => setIncluirDevoluciones(!incluirDevoluciones)}
                        className={`relative inline-flex h-4 w-7 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out focus:outline-none ${
                          incluirDevoluciones ? 'bg-slate-900' : 'bg-slate-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-3 w-3 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow ring-0 transition duration-200 ease-in-out ${
                            incluirDevoluciones ? 'translate-x-3' : 'translate-x-0'
                          }`}
                        />
                      </button>
                      <span className={`text-xs transition-colors ${incluirDevoluciones ? 'text-slate-900 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
                        Incluir Devoluciones
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>



              {/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */}
              {/* BARRA GENERAL UNIFICADA COLAPSABLE: + AÑADIR INSUMO                */}
              {/* Inicialmente muestra solo el botón + Añadir insumo en toda pestaña */}

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setIsAddingGeneralInsumo(true);
                      setTimeout(() => generalSearchInputRef.current?.focus(), 60);
                    }}

                  >
                    <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span>Añadir insumo</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-slate-300 bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-700">
                      {activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && 'Traslados'}
                      {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA' && 'Apertura'}
                      {activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' && 'Devoluciones'}
                      {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE' && 'Cierre'}
                      {activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' && 'Consumos'}
                      {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA' && 'Bodega Apertura'}
                      {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE' && 'Bodega Cierre'}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  {generalAddSuccessMsg && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium animate-fade-in shadow-2xs">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{generalAddSuccessMsg}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 shadow-2xs space-y-3 relative z-30 transition-all">
                {/* Encabezado estético de la barra desplegada */}
                <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs shrink-0">
                      <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span>Añadir Insumo</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full normal-case">
                          ✓ Auto-clasifica categoría
                        </span>
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        Registrando en:{' '}
                        <strong className="text-slate-800">
                          {activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && 'Traslados Bodega a Cocina'}
                          {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA' && 'Cocina Apertura'}
                          {activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' && 'Devoluciones Cocina a Bodega'}
                          {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE' && 'Cocina Cierre'}
                          {activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' && 'Consumos'}
                          {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA' && 'Bodega Apertura'}
                          {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE' && 'Bodega Cierre'}
                        </strong>
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setIsAddingGeneralInsumo(false);
                      setIsSearchOpen(false);
                    }}

                    title="Ocultar formulario"
                  >
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span className="hidden sm:inline">Cerrar</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Formulario unificado de entrada en una sola línea responsiva */}
                <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-stretch lg:items-center gap-2">
                  {/* 1. Buscador Inteligente en todo el catálogo */}
                  <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[260px] z-50">
                    <div className="relative flex items-center z-10">
                      <Search className="absolute left-3 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 pointer-events-none" />
                      <input
                        ref={generalSearchInputRef}
                        type="text"
                        value={newInsumoName}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          setNewInsumoName(val);
                          setIsSearchOpen(true);
                          const exact = effectiveGeneralCatalog.find(
                            it => (it.nombre || it.insumo || '').toLowerCase() === val.trim().toLowerCase()
                          );
                          if (exact) {
                            const price = Number(exact.costo_unitario_kg || exact.precio_total || exact.precio_neto || exact.precio_venta || 0);
                            if (price > 0) setNewInsumoPrice(price);
                            setSelectedCatalogItem(exact);
                            const units = getAllowedUnitsForInsumo(exact);
                            setAvailableUnits(units);
                            setNewInsumoUnit(units[0].value);
                          }
                        }}
                        onFocus={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                          if (e.key === 'Enter' && !isSearchOpen) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            addQtyInputRef.current?.focus();
                          }
                        }}
                        placeholder={
                          activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS'
                            ? "Buscar insumo o producto para venta (ej: Punta de anca, Gatorade, Tomate)..."
                            : "Buscar cualquier insumo (ej: Punta de anca, Tomate, Arroz, Vasos, Cerveza)..."
                        }
                        className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 bg-slate-50/70 hover:bg-white focus:bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-800 transition-all font-medium placeholder:text-slate-400 shadow-2xs"
                      />
                      {newInsumoName && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setNewInsumoName('');
                            setSelectedCatalogItem(null);
                          }}
                          className="absolute right-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer"
                          title="Limpiar"
                        >
                          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Backdrop invisible para cerrar dropdown al hacer clic afuera */}
                    {isSearchOpen && (
                      <div
                        className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-transparent"
                        onClick={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)}
                      />
                    )}

                    {/* Dropdown de Autocompletado del Catálogo con todas las categorías */}
                    {isSearchOpen && (
                      <div className="absolute left-0 top-full mt-1.5 w-full sm:w-[500px] max-h-84 overflow-y-auto bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 divide-y divide-slate-100 animate-fade-in ring-1 ring-slate-900/10">
                        {/* Píldoras de filtro rápido por categoría */}
                        <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
                          {[
                            { id: 'TODOS', label: 'Todos' },
                            { id: 'CARNES', label: '🥩 Carnes' },
                            { id: 'VERDURAS', label: '🥬 Verduras' },
                            { id: 'GRANOS', label: '🌾 Granos' },
                            { id: 'DESECHABLES', label: '📦 Desechables' },
                            { id: 'BEBIDAS', label: '🥤 Bebidas' },
                            { id: 'HUEVOS', label: '🥚 Lácteos/Huevos' }
                          ].map(pill => (
                            <button
                              key={pill.id}
                              type="button"
                              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                setSearchCategoryFilter(pill.id);
                              }}
                              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                                searchCategoryFilter === pill.id
                                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white font-semibold'
                                  : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {pill.label}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>

                        {filteredGeneralCatalog.length > 0 ? (
                          filteredGeneralCatalog.slice(0, 20).map((cItem) => {
                            const stdW = cItem.peso_estandar_porcion_kg || (cItem.peso_porc_gramos ? cItem.peso_porc_gramos / 1000 : 0);
                            return (
                              <div
                                key={cItem.id || cItem.codigo || cItem.nombre || cItem.insumo}
                                onMouseDown={() => handleSelectCatalogItem(cItem)}
                                className="p-2.5 px-3.5 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between text-xs transition-colors"
                              >
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pr-2">
                                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
                                    <span>{cItem.nombre || cItem.insumo}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="mt-0.5">
                                    <span className={`inline-block text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border font-medium uppercase tracking-wide ${getCategoryBadgeStyle(cItem.categoria)}`}>
                                      {cItem.categoria}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                                  <div className="font-mono font-medium text-slate-800 text-xs">
                                    ${(cItem.costo_unitario_kg || cItem.precio_total || 0).toLocaleString('es-CO')}/{cItem.unidad_medida || 'Kg'}
                                  </div>
                                  {stdW > 0 && (
                                    <span className="text-[9px] bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 px-1 py-0.2 rounded border border-amber-200/80">
                                      {Math.round(stdW * 1000)}g/porc
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            );
                          })
                        ) : (
                          <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                            No se encontraron insumos para &ldquo;{newInsumoName}&rdquo; en el catálogo. Puedes agregarlo escribiendo los valores y haciendo clic en Guardar.
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Pie informativo */}
                        <div className="p-2 px-3.5 bg-slate-50 text-[10px] text-slate-500 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span>Catálogo activo: {effectiveGeneralCatalog.length} insumos</span>
                          <span>{filteredGeneralCatalog.length} coincidencias</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* 2. Campo Cantidad con soporte para fórmulas */}
                  <div className="w-full sm:w-36 shrink-0">
                    <input
                      ref={addQtyInputRef}
                      type="text"
                      value={newInsumoQtyFormula}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewInsumoQtyFormula(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleAddItem();
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder={newInsumoUnit === 'Porciones' ? 'Porciones (ej: 4)' : 'Cantidad (ej: 5 + 2)'}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-800 font-mono shadow-2xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* 3. Selector de Unidad Parametrizado */}
                  <div className="w-full sm:w-28 shrink-0">
                    <select
                      value={newInsumoUnit}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewInsumoUnit(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-800 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                    >
                      {availableUnits.map((u) => (
                        <option key={u.value} value={u.value}>
                          {u.label}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  {/* 4. Costo Factura / Precio Venta */}
                  <div className="w-full sm:w-36 shrink-0">
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={newInsumoPrice}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewInsumoPrice(e.target.value === '' ? '' : Number(e.target.value))}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleAddItem();
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder={activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' ? 'Precio Venta ($)' : 'Costo Unit ($)'}
                      title="Costo o precio unitario"
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-800 font-mono shadow-2xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* 5. Si es CONSUMOS: Responsable */}
                  {activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' && (
                    <div className="w-full sm:w-36 shrink-0">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={consumoResponsable}
                        onChange={(e) => setConsumoResponsable(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Responsable (ej: Juan)"
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-800 font-sans shadow-2xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* 6. Botones de Acción */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 justify-end">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleAddItem()}
                      disabled={!newInsumoName.trim()}
                      className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer ${
                        newInsumoName.trim()
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white active:scale-98'
                          : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Guardar Conteo</span>
                    </button>

                    {(newInsumoName || newInsumoQtyFormula) && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setNewInsumoName('');
                          setNewInsumoQtyFormula('');
                          setSelectedCatalogItem(null);
                          setNewInsumoPrice('');
                          setIsSearchOpen(false);
                        }}
                        className="bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        title="Limpiar campos"
                      >
                        <Eraser className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Previsualización en Vivo de Detección de Categoría y Conversión */}
                {(newInsumoName.trim() || generalParsedAddQty > 0 || Number(newInsumoPrice) > 0) && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/90 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg font-mono flex-wrap animate-fade-in">
                    {/* Badge de Detección de Categoría Automática */}
                    {generalPreviewCategory && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-sans font-medium text-slate-500">Se ubicará en:</span>
                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border shadow-2xs ${getCategoryBadgeStyle(generalPreviewCategory.catNameToSave)}`}>
                          {generalPreviewCategory.catNameToSave}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {generalParsedAddQty > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700">
                          Cantidad: <strong>{generalParsedAddQty} {newInsumoUnit}</strong>
                          {generalSelectedUnitOpt && generalSelectedUnitOpt.baseUnit !== newInsumoUnit && (
                            <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] ml-1">
                              (= {generalConvertedBaseQty} {generalSelectedUnitOpt.baseUnit})
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </>
                    )}

                    {Number(newInsumoPrice) > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700">
                          {activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' ? 'Precio Unit:' : 'Costo Unit:'}{' '}
                          <strong>${Number(newInsumoPrice).toLocaleString('es-CO')}</strong>
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
                        <span className="text-emerald-800 font-bold bg-emerald-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-300 shadow-2xs">
                          Subtotal: ${generalEstimatedCost.toLocaleString('es-CO')} COP
                        </span>
                      </>
                    )}

                    {newInsumoUnit === 'Porciones' && (
                      <span className="text-amber-700 text-[10px] font-sans ml-auto">
                        ({generalParsedAddQty} porciones calculadas según ficha técnica)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Banner Temporal de Notificación de Guardado Exitoso */}
                {generalAddSuccessMsg && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium animate-fade-in shadow-2xs">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{generalAddSuccessMsg}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              )}

              {/* Barra de utilidades: Expandir/Colapsar categorías */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 mb-2">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Categorías de Insumos ({activeSheet.categories.length})
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={expandAllCategories}
                    className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 font-medium hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Expandir todas
                  </button>
                  <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={collapseAllCategories}
                    className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 font-medium hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Colapsar todas
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* LISTADO DE CATEGORÍAS */}
              {(activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' 
                ? (() => {
                    const existingInsumos = activeSheet.categories.find(c => c.id === 'consumos_insumos' || c.name.toLowerCase().includes('insumos y carne'));
                    const existingProds = activeSheet.categories.find(c => c.id === 'consumos_productos' || c.name.toLowerCase().includes('productos para la venta'));
                    return [
                      existingInsumos || {
                        id: 'consumos_insumos',
                        name: 'Consumido del Catálogo de Insumos y Carne',
                        items: [],
                        subtotal: 0,
                        itemsCount: 0
                      },
                      existingProds || {
                        id: 'consumos_productos',
                        name: 'Consumido de Productos para la Venta',
                        items: [],
                        subtotal: 0,
                        itemsCount: 0
                      }
                    ];
                  })()
                : activeSheet.categories.filter(cat => cat.id !== 'consumos_insumos' && cat.id !== 'consumos_productos' && !cat.name.toLowerCase().includes('consumido'))
              ).map((cat) => {
                const isCollapsed = Boolean(collapsedCategories[cat.id]);
                const catViewTotal = calculateCategoryViewTotal(cat);
                
                // Filtrar items según la vista activa
                const displayItems = cat.items.filter(it => {
                  const m = getItemMetricsForView(it);
                  if (activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS') {
                    // Si no se incluye cocina apertura, no mostrar insumos que queden en cero
                    if (!incluirCocinaApertura) {
                      return m.hasEntries && m.qty > 0;
                    }
                    return m.hasEntries;
                  }
                  return m.hasEntries;
                });

                return (
                  <div
                    key={cat.id}
                    className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-2xs transition-all relative z-0 overflow-hidden"
                  >
                    
                    {/* Encabezado de Categoría Interactivo con Expandir/Contraer */}
                    <div 
                      onClick={() => toggleCategoryCollapse(cat.id)}
                      className="p-2.5 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 hover:bg-slate-100/70 transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className={`text-[10px] text-slate-500 transition-transform duration-200 inline-block ${isCollapsed ? '-rotate-90' : 'rotate-0'}`}>
                          ▼
                        </span>
                        <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide">
                          {cat.name}
                        </h2>
                        <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-medium">
                          {displayItems.length}
                        </span>
                        {isCollapsed && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal italic">
                            (contraído - clic para ver insumos)
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        Subtotal: <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">${catViewTotal.toLocaleString('es-CO')}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {!isCollapsed && (
                      <>
                    {/* Encabezado de Columnas */}
                    <div className="hidden sm:grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 p-2 px-4 bg-white border-b border-slate-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      <div className="col-span-6">Insumo / Producto</div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 text-right">Cantidad</div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 text-right">
                        {cat.id === 'consumos_productos' ? 'Precio Venta' : 'Costo Factura'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 text-right">Subtotal</div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Filas de Insumos */}
