                        const metrics = getItemMetricsForView(item);

                        return (
                          <div key={item.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50/80">
                            {/* VISTA MÓVIL (< sm): Tarjeta Nativa Touch de Alta Densidad */}
                            <div className="sm:hidden p-3 active:bg-slate-100 transition-colors">
                              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5">
                                {/* Columna Izquierda: Nombre, Categoría y Badges */}
                                <div 
                                  className="flex-1 min-w-0 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenInsumoManager(cat.id, cat.name, item)}
                                >
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs leading-snug">
                                      {item.name}
                                    </span>
                                    {item.isInitialInventory && activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && incluirCocinaApertura && (
                                      <span className="text-[9px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-1 py-0.2 rounded border border-slate-200 shrink-0 font-medium">
                                        Apertura
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </div>

                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 font-mono">
                                    {item.sourceInvoice ? (
                                      <div className="relative group/inv inline-block" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                                        <button
                                          type="button"
                                          onClick={(e) => {
                                            e.stopPropagation();
                                            setOpenInvoiceTooltipId((prev) => (prev === `m-${item.id}` ? null : `m-${item.id}`));
                                          }}
                                          className="cursor-pointer touch-manipulation underline decoration-dotted decoration-orange-400 text-slate-700 font-semibold active:text-orange-600"
                                        >
                                          ${item.unitPrice.toLocaleString('es-CO')}/{item.unit}
                                        </button>
                                        <div
                                          className={`${
                                            openInvoiceTooltipId === `m-${item.id}` ? 'block' : 'hidden group-hover/inv:block'
                                          } absolute left-0 bottom-full pb-1.5 z-50 w-64`}
                                        >
                                          <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-lg p-2.5 shadow-xl border border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-sans leading-relaxed">
                                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-700 pb-1 mb-1">
                                              <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium">Factura:</span>
                                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                <a
                                                  href={`/compras?factura=${encodeURIComponent(item.sourceInvoice.numeroFactura)}&fecha=${encodeURIComponent(item.sourceInvoice.fecha)}`}
                                                  target="_blank"
                                                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                                  className="text-orange-400 hover:text-orange-300 font-bold underline"
                                                >
                                                  {item.sourceInvoice.numeroFactura} ↗
                                                </a>
                                                <button
                                                  type="button"
                                                  onClick={(e) => {
                                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                                    setOpenInvoiceTooltipId(null);
                                                  }}
                                                  className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white px-1 leading-none cursor-pointer"
                                                  aria-label="Cerrar"
                                                >
                                                  ✕
                                                </button>
                                              </div>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                                              <span className="text-slate-400">Fecha:</span>
                                              <span className="font-mono">{item.sourceInvoice.fecha}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                                              <span className="text-slate-400">Proveedor:</span>
                                              <span className="truncate max-w-[140px]" title={item.sourceInvoice.proveedor}>{item.sourceInvoice.proveedor}</span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 mt-0.5 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                                              <span className="text-slate-400">Costo Unit.:</span>
                                              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400">
                                                ${item.sourceInvoice.costoUnitario.toLocaleString('es-CO')} /{item.sourceInvoice.unidad}
                                              </span>
                                            </div>
                                          </div>
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    ) : (
                                      <span>${item.unitPrice.toLocaleString('es-CO')}/{item.unit}</span>
                                    )}
                                    <span>•</span>
                                    <span className="text-slate-600 font-medium underline decoration-dotted">
                                      {metrics.filteredRegs.length} {metrics.filteredRegs.length === 1 ? 'reg' : 'regs'}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>

                                {/* Columna Derecha: Cantidad Destacada, Subtotal y Botón Eliminar */}
                                <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <div 
                                    className="text-right cursor-pointer touch-manipulation"
                                    onClick={() => handleOpenInsumoManager(cat.id, cat.name, item)}
                                  >
                                    <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 font-mono bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md inline-block">
                                      {metrics.qty} <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600">{item.unit}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    {item.equivNote && item.unit === 'Kg' && (
                                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">({item.equivNote})</div>
                                    )}
                                    <div className="text-xs font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                                      ${metrics.total.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                                    </div>
                                  </div>

                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={(e) => {
                                      e.stopPropagation();
                                      handleDeleteItem(cat.id, item.id);
                                    }}
                                    className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 active:scale-90 p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-rose-50 transition-all cursor-pointer touch-manipulation"
                                    title="Eliminar insumo"
                                  >
                                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* VISTA DESKTOP (>= sm): Tabla Grid de 12 Columnas */}
                            <div className="hidden sm:grid sm:grid-cols-12 gap-2 p-2.5 px-4 items-center text-xs">
                              {/* Nombre Clicable - Abre Administrador Lateral */}
                              <div className="sm:col-span-6 flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenInsumoManager(cat.id, cat.name, item)}
                                  className="text-left font-semibold text-slate-900 hover:text-orange-600 flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors group cursor-pointer truncate"
                                  title="Click para ver desglose de registros e ingresar más cantidades"
                                >
                                  <span className="group-hover:underline truncate">{item.name}</span>
                                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 group-hover:bg-orange-50 group-hover:text-orange-700 transition-colors shrink-0">
                                    {metrics.filteredRegs.length} {metrics.filteredRegs.length === 1 ? 'registro' : 'registros'}
                                  </span>
                                </button>
                                {item.isInitialInventory && activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && incluirCocinaApertura && (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-slate-200 shrink-0">
                                    Apertura
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>

                              {/* Cantidad y Unidad */}
                              <div className="sm:col-span-2 sm:text-right font-medium text-slate-900 font-mono">
                                <div>{metrics.qty} {item.unit}</div>
                                {item.equivNote && item.unit === 'Kg' && (
                                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal">({item.equivNote})</div>
                                )}
                              </div>

                              {/* Costo Factura */}
                              <div className="sm:col-span-2 sm:text-right text-slate-600 font-mono">
                                {item.sourceInvoice ? (
                                  <div className="relative group/inv inline-block" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={(e) => {
                                        e.stopPropagation();
                                        setOpenInvoiceTooltipId((prev) => (prev === `d-${item.id}` ? null : `d-${item.id}`));
                                      }}
                                      className="cursor-pointer underline decoration-dotted decoration-orange-400 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors"
                                    >
                                      ${item.unitPrice.toLocaleString('es-CO')} /{item.unit}
                                    </button>
                                    <div
                                      className={`${
                                        openInvoiceTooltipId === `d-${item.id}` ? 'block' : 'hidden group-hover/inv:block'
                                      } absolute right-0 bottom-full pb-1.5 z-50 w-64 text-left`}
                                    >
                                      <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-lg p-2.5 shadow-xl border border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-sans leading-relaxed">
                                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-700 pb-1 mb-1">
                                          <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium">Factura:</span>
                                          <a
                                            href={`/compras?factura=${encodeURIComponent(item.sourceInvoice.numeroFactura)}&fecha=${encodeURIComponent(item.sourceInvoice.fecha)}`}
                                            target="_blank"
                                            rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                            className="text-orange-400 hover:text-orange-300 font-bold underline"
                                          >
                                            {item.sourceInvoice.numeroFactura} ↗
                                          </a>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                                          <span className="text-slate-400">Fecha:</span>
                                          <span className="font-mono">{item.sourceInvoice.fecha}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                                          <span className="text-slate-400">Proveedor:</span>
                                          <span className="truncate max-w-[140px]" title={item.sourceInvoice.proveedor}>{item.sourceInvoice.proveedor}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 mt-0.5 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                                          <span className="text-slate-400">Costo Unit.:</span>
                                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400">
                                            ${item.sourceInvoice.costoUnitario.toLocaleString('es-CO')} /{item.sourceInvoice.unidad}
                                          </span>
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  <span>${item.unitPrice.toLocaleString('es-CO')} /{item.unit}</span>
                                )}
                              </div>

                              {/* Subtotal y Eliminar */}
                              <div className="sm:col-span-2 flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end gap-3">
                                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                                  ${metrics.total.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                                </span>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(cat.id, item.id)}
                                  className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 p-1 rounded hover:bg-rose-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  title="Eliminar insumo"
                                >
                                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}

                      {/* Estado Vacío */}
                      {displayItems.length === 0 && (
                        <div className="p-3 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 italic">
                          Sin registros activos para esta categoría en la vista seleccionada.
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Columna Derecha: Contenedor de Liquidaciones y Enlaces de Navegación */}
            <aside className="w-full lg:w-80 xl:w-88 shrink-0 space-y-4 lg:sticky lg:top-4">
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-2xs space-y-4">
                {/* Encabezado: LIQUIDACIÓN COCINA DEL DIA */}
                <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-2.5">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    LIQUIDACIÓN COCINA DEL DIA
                  </h3>
                </div>

                {/* Cifras Operativas Linkeadas a sus respectivas hojas */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                  {/* 1. Costo Cocina Apertura (Linkeado) */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('COCINA_APERTURA')}
                    className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                      activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA'
                        ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                      Costo Cocina Apertura :
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium text-slate-900">
                        ${costoApertura.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                      </span>
                      {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_APERTURA' && (
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* 2. Costo Movimientos a Cocina (suma) (Linkeado) */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('TRASLADOS')}
                    className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                      activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS'
                        ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                      Costo Movimientos a Cocina :
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium text-emerald-700">
                        +${costoTraslados.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                      </span>
                      {activeOperationalView === 'TRASLADOS' && (
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* 3. Costo Devoluciones a Bodega (resta) (Linkeado) */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('DEVOLUCIONES')}
                    className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                      activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES'
                        ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                      Costo Devoluciones a Bodega :
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium text-amber-700">
                        -${totalDevoluciones.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                      </span>
                      {activeOperationalView === 'DEVOLUCIONES' && (
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* 4. Costo Cocina Cierre (resta) (Linkeado) */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('COCINA_CIERRE')}
                    className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                      activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE'
                        ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                      Costo Cocina Cierre :
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium text-blue-700">
                        -${costoCierre.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                      </span>
                      {activeOperationalView === 'COCINA_CIERRE' && (
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* 5. Costo Consumos (suma) (Linkeado) */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('CONSUMOS')}
                    className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                      activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS'
                        ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                      Costo Consumos :
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium text-purple-700">
                        +${costoConsumos.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                      </span>
                      {activeOperationalView === 'CONSUMOS' && (
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* Costo Consumo Real Total */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2.5 pb-2.5 border-t border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/80 -mx-4 px-4 my-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">Costo Consumo Real :</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 text-sm">
                      ${consumoReal.toLocaleString('es-CO')} <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-sans font-normal">(Total)</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Ventas del Día */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                    <span className="text-slate-600">Total de Ventas del día :</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-medium text-slate-900">
                      ${ventasDia.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Rendimiento */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-200">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">Rendimiento :</span>
                    <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${rendimientoDia >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-rose-600'}`}>
                      {rendimientoDia >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$'}{Math.abs(rendimientoDia).toLocaleString('es-CO')} COP
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Food Cost */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                    <span className="text-slate-600">Food Cost :</span>
                    <span className={`font-mono font-semibold ${foodCostPct <= 35 ? 'text-emerald-700' : foodCostPct <= 45 ? 'text-amber-700' : 'text-rose-600'}`}>
                      {foodCostPct.toFixed(1)}%
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* LIQUIDACIÓN BODEGA DEL DIA */}
                <div className="border-t border-slate-200 pt-3">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 mb-2">
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide">
                      LIQUIDACIÓN BODEGA DEL DIA
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                    {/* Bodega Apertura con total liquidado */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('BODEGA_APERTURA')}
                      className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                        activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA'
                          ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                          : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className={activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                        Bodega Apertura :
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium text-slate-900">
                          ${costoBodegaApertura.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                        </span>
                        {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_APERTURA' && (
                          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </button>

                    {/* Bodega Cierre con total liquidado */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setActiveOperationalView('BODEGA_CIERRE')}
                      className={`w-full text-left py-1.5 px-2 rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                        activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE'
                          ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                          : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className={activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE' ? 'underline' : ''}>
                        Bodega Cierre :
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium text-slate-900">
                          ${costoBodegaCierre.toLocaleString('es-CO')}
                        </span>
                        {activeOperationalView === 'BODEGA_CIERRE' && (
                          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </aside>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>

      {/* ============================================================ */}
      {/* 3. MODAL: "+ NUEVA HOJA DE COSTEO" (Sobrio)                  */}
      {/* ============================================================ */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4">
          <div 
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/65 backdrop-blur-sm z-0 transition-opacity animate-in fade-in duration-200"
            onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
          />
          <div 
            className="relative z-10 isolate bg-white rounded-xl max-w-md w-full p-5 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200/90 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3 mb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">Nueva Hoja de Costeo</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Elige la fecha para generar el documento oficial.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSheet} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Selector de Fecha */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Fecha de la Operación:
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={newDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md text-xs font-medium text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-500"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Título Autogenerado */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Título de la Hoja:
                </label>
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-md text-xs font-medium text-slate-800">

                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-orange-500" />
                    <span>Verificando cierres del día anterior ({prevCierreStatus.prevDate})...</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Checkbox 1: Importar Cierre de Cocina (Solo si hay cierre de cocina registrado en el día anterior) */}
                {!prevCierreStatus.loading && prevCierreStatus.hasCocinaCierre && (
                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 cursor-pointer p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-50/70 border border-orange-200/80 hover:bg-orange-100/60 transition-colors">

                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={importCocinaCierre}
                      onChange={(e) => setImportCocinaCierre(e.target.checked)}
                      className="mt-0.5 rounded border-orange-300 text-orange-600 focus:ring-orange-500 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <div className="text-xs select-none">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 block leading-tight">
                        Importar cierre de cocina del día anterior ({prevCierreStatus.prevDate})
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 block mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                        Ingresa como inventario que amanece en cocina ({prevCierreStatus.cocinaCount} insumos contados).
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </label>
                )}

                {/* Checkbox 2: Importar Cierre de Bodega (Solo si hay insumos contados en cierre de bodega del día anterior) */}
                {!prevCierreStatus.loading && prevCierreStatus.hasBodegaCierre && (
                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 cursor-pointer p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50/70 border border-emerald-200/80 hover:bg-emerald-100/60 transition-colors">

                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={importBodegaCierre}
                      onChange={(e) => setImportBodegaCierre(e.target.checked)}
                      className="mt-0.5 rounded border-emerald-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <div className="text-xs select-none">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 block leading-tight">
                        Importar cierre de bodega del día anterior ({prevCierreStatus.prevDate})
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 block mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                        Ingresa como inventario inicial en bodega ({prevCierreStatus.bodegaCount} insumos contados).
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </label>
                )}

                {/* Mensaje informativo si el día anterior NO tiene ningún cierre diligenciado */}
                {!prevCierreStatus.loading && !prevCierreStatus.hasCocinaCierre && !prevCierreStatus.hasBodegaCierre && (
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Sin inventario de cierre previo</p>

                    </p>
                  </div>

              </div>

              {/* Botones de Acción */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">

                    </>

                    <>
                      <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal de Confirmación para Limpiar / Resetear Hoja con Checkboxes */}

                </p>

                </button>
                <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>

                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Listado de Checkboxes de Hojas */}

                clearSheetsSelection.apertura

              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"

                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-rose-600 border-slate-300 focus:ring-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold block">Cocina Apertura</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Inventario inicial con el que amaneció cocina</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold block text-slate-800">
                    ${clearSheetStats.apertura.total.toLocaleString('es-CO')}

                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                    {clearSheetStats.apertura.count} registros
                  </span>

                  <div>

                <div className="text-right">

                    {clearSheetStats.movimientos.count} registros

                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-rose-600 border-slate-300 focus:ring-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold block">Cocina Devoluciones</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Devoluciones de insumos devueltos de Cocina a Bodega</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold block text-slate-800">
                    ${clearSheetStats.devoluciones.total.toLocaleString('es-CO')}

                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">

                  <div>

                <div className="text-right">

                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                    {clearSheetStats.bodegaApertura.count} registros
                  </span>

              </label>

              {/* 6. Bodega Cierre */}
              <label className={`flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-md border transition-all cursor-pointer ${

                Cancelar
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"

              >
                {isResettingSheet ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />

                        ? 'Limpiar todas las hojas'
                        : `Limpiar (${Object.values(clearSheetsSelection).filter(Boolean).length}) seleccionadas`}
                    </span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>

          </div>

                exportPdfSelection.apertura
                  ? 'bg-slate-900/5 border-slate-400 text-slate-950 shadow-2xs'
                  : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100/60'
              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={exportPdfSelection.apertura}

                  <div>

                <div className="text-right">

                  </span>

                  ? 'bg-slate-900/5 border-slate-400 text-slate-950 shadow-2xs'
                  : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100/60'

                <label className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 cursor-pointer">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">

                    />
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold block">Cocina Movimientos</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Traslados de bodega a cocina durante el día</span>
                    </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold block text-slate-800">

                          ? clearSheetStats.movimientos.total + clearSheetStats.apertura.total

                      Incluir Cocina Apertura dentro de Movimientos
                    </span>
